title: Ten typefaces beside the mark
intro: Each option shows the chosen mark with the wordmark on light and dark, plus the headline in the same face. All ten are free and can be self-hosted.
headline: Calm, private software for everyday life.

fonts.note: Literary and composed, and it matches the site’s headings.
Warm, rounded serifs that echo the round dots. It has a little more personality.
Tall, narrow and elegant. It feels quiet and a bit fashionable.
Heavy and friendly, like an old bookplate. It holds up at small sizes.
Precise and very calm, the plainest option. The mark does the talking.
Round o and e forms that repeat the dot geometry exactly.
Clear and approachable, with slightly humanist curves. Reads well everywhere.
Wide and airy. It reads as a modern software company.
Crisp and confident, with tight curves, like an established product studio.
Rounded terminals that match the dots. The gentlest and most consumer-friendly.
